study.question: Does deleting the added residual projected-content path preserve or improve the small raw-rate residual gain over the strong pair-joint backbone? The feedback-versus-count contrast without content remains deferred.
study.hypothesis: Observation: content_rates has validation macro AUC0.8315142702328122, only0.0001047511717405 above g0 and0.0001155625481415 above matched content_counts; macro Logloss is0.0000078268383914 worse than g0. Diversity/exposure transfer is nearly tied, replacing joint pairs by marginals loses about0.00061, and all three smoothed/background-rate arms fall below the incumbent. The backbone may already encode the projected content, while direct group feedback proportions supply a small complementary low-order signal. Removing residual content may reduce interference without removing that signal. This is a prospective, local sufficiency hypothesis; no novel mechanism or seed-robust improvement is established.

falsifiers: rate_only below content_rates opposes sufficiency of raw rates without residual projected content at this initialization.
The zero-content feedback-versus-count falsifier is unassessed: count_only is deferred. No result of rate_only can alone prove that its raw feedback-rate inputs drive a gain.
Failure to beat the stronger frozen source precludes measured source superiority; gains within unmeasured seed variation do not establish repeated support.

A gain caused by changed backbone initialization, input visibility, labels, host recipe, parameter construction or scorer is invalid and requires a charged failed receipt, not a new scientific conclusion.
Any later permitted paired repetition that removes the gain would oppose stable added utility; no such repetition is affordable or performed here.
alternative_explanations: Optimization/scale and effective feature rank, not new information, can drive replacement effects.
Same-seed adaptively selected differences near1e-4 may be noise or selection optimism; no confidence interval or statistical significance is available.
The content_rates improvement could partly be extra residual capacity/counts already in the core rather than a diversity or factorization mechanism.
Auxiliary labels reflect same-user/category/brand actions within24h, not direct advertisement conversions; offline action visibility may not be mature in production.
Different wall costs can reflect runtime variability or retained dead diagnostic computation rather than deployable efficiency.
